prompt: Phase 09 Prompt 25 — Deterministic vs Semantic Benchmark
objective: Benchmark deterministic vs semantic vs hybrid retrieval over the approved corpus — comparative, bucketed, metadata-only metrics; advisory (assembles_final_answer=false), read-only by default, fail-closed.

summary.migrator_change: None — reuses the existing V38 second_brain_retrieval_benchmark_runs table; schema stays 38, contract table count stays 190.
summary.embeddings: Advisory semantic path embeds probes via the applied vector index (LlamaIndex / bge-small or MockEmbedding offline); deterministic baseline uses no embeddings. Probes are runtime-only and never persisted.

design.deterministic: RetrievalBroker.retrieve(...) — authoritative, query-free corpus baseline (computed once).
design.semantic: One advisory _semantic_query per runtime probe over the applied vector index; floored at review tier 2, source-linked, re-validated no-raw; fail-closed (blocked semantic_status) when the SDK / applied index is absent.
design.hybrid: Deterministic + net-new advisory semantic (semantic refs are hashed, disjoint from the deterministic raw-ref space).
design.probes: Built at runtime from each approved node's already-redacted excerpt (_build_probes); used in-memory only as semantic queries; never persisted or emitted. Capped at max_probes (50) with a surfaced warning — no silent truncation.
design.metrics: Seven bucketed (metric, mode) rows: result_count:{deterministic,semantic,hybrid}, semantic_hit_rate:hybrid, semantic_lift:hybrid, tier_floor:semantic, semantic_status:hybrid. Stored to benchmark_runs (run_id, eval_set_id linkage, config_snapshot_id, metric_name, metric_value_label) — metadata-only, guard-clean.
design.doctrine: Measurement leaf — assembles_final_answer=false and the semantic_retrieval_bypassed_policy guard stays 0; semantic context never reaches an answer / Research Packet / Evaluation path from here.
design.read_only: emit_receipt defaults False (no operator-DB write); receipt persistence (benchmark_runs, metadata-only, guard-clean) exercised in the proof on a temp DB.

operator_db_outcome.rationale: The operator DB has no approved Obsidian/reviewed-memory outputs -> no probes -> the benchmark is honestly empty. emit_receipt defaulted False -> no persist.

real_huggingface_smoke.note: End-to-end real LlamaIndex + HuggingFace pipeline: applied index embedded dim-384 vectors; the benchmark compared all three modes and emitted seven bucketed metric rows.
